description: Ministry of Labour & Trade Union Relations - Appointed Mr. R. S. Ariyapperuma as arbitrator to the Industrial Dispute between S. C. L. K. Wickramaratne & The Employees' Trust Fund Board - Appointed Mr. S. M. J. Jayawardena as arbitrator to the Industrial Dispute between Ceylon Plantation & Mercantile Services Union and Agalawatta Plantation PLC - Appointed Mr. s. M. S. Jayawardena as arbitrator to the Industrial Dispute between W. L. A. de Silva and Ceylon Electricity Board
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns legal/regulatory matters under the Industrial Disputes Act, specifically orders made under Section 4(1) to appoint arbitrators for industrial disputes. It involves statutory instruments and legal procedures for dispute resolution between employers and employees, falling squarely within the Legal/Regulatory classification category (Type 5). While it mentions a government minister (W. D. J. Seneviratne), the content focuses on legal procedures and regulatory actions rather than government personnel changes or structural modifications.
